notes.title: Streamline 2.6: The bug squashingest release of all. time.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/15302276/de1112739b37c2259654828962e785241c3a99d1.png[/img]

If you get excited for game updates that are all about fixing stuff up, well…you better hold onto your butts…Streamline 2.6 is here! We geared up and busted a bunch of bugs to make the [strike]world[/strike] game a safer place for all [strike]of humanity[/strike] players.

Seriously, though, this update is mostly focused on tidying up while we prepare some bigger content that still needs to bake a little longer. More stuff, coming soon!

[b]Now, all the fixes![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/15302276/5298e838c534d9c95a324f2fd4caa8243f0fe31c.gif[/img]
[i]Actual footage of our dev team working on this release[/i]

[h1]Gameplay stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Teams will no longer become uneven when Players join a Bitball game mid-match. Fair game is fair!
[*]Charged throws during Bitball now correctly trigger passing bonuses. Go long!
[*]The Ragdoll rule was causing horrific disfigurations instead of silly floppiness. Sorry for the nightmares!
[*]Fixed an issue where Bitball players couldn’t punch former teammates during the following pre-match free play. Alliances are fleeting once again!
[*]In Tag mode with two players, Runner deaths caused by the environment no longer trigger Red Zones. You should still try to not fall off the map, though.
[*]Corrected a situation where Players sometimes couldn't eliminate each other during Not So Sudden Death in a Tag match.
[*]The Long Wharf map no longer has phantom lava during the Floor is Lava rule. You’ll only get hurt when you make the questionable decision to step on visible lava now!
[*]In Tag mode, Players will no longer incorrectly get the “Skin of Your Teeth” bonus when they tag a Runner. Because that makes absolutely no sense.
[/list]

[h1]Other stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the level-up screen for Level 50 players who were seeing some crazy negative numbers.
[*]A handful of localization improvements, including adding some missing translations and fixing bad layouts.
[*]Players will no longer get stuck with a nine-player party in Bitball.
[*]Twitch chat messages that are purged by moderators will now get purged in the in-game chat display.
[*]Fixed some instances where post-match Bitball results didn’t add up properly.
[*]Players who would get a “game not found” error when trying to join an invite-only game via Steam should no longer run into this problem.
[*]Improvements were made to the mid-match Rule Store to make it less awkward when the match features multiple broadcasters.
[/list]

[h1]Other, other stuff[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added some back-end features to make it easier for our community and support team to help players out with linking/unlinking Steam and Twitch accounts. 
[*]A bunch of miscellaneous bug fixes.
[/list]

As always, if you notice any issues or have any feedback, we’d love to hear from you! Head over to [url=discord.gg/proletariat]our Discord server[/url] and leave a note in the Feedback or Support section and our community team will be glad to help you out.

notes.title: 2.4 needed some love! (patch notes for fix-it release 2.4.65)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Steam players with non-ASCII characters in their display name not being able to log in.
[*] Fixed the Bitball disappearing if the player holding the ball disconnects.
[*] Fixed players sometimes having "(1)" appended to their name. 
[*] Players who quick match and then leave the match will now correctly leave the Streamote party.
[*] Fixed issues where players would get stuck in the "throwing ball" animation.
[*] Generally improved netcode for movement/attacks/throwing.
[*] Fixed the rewards screen at end of match not appearing sometimes.
[*] A few other miscellaneous crash fixes.
[*] Fixed Bitball scoreboards not showing up or not updating in Streamote sometimes.
[*] Fixed a hole in the geometry in Overpass that the Bitball could fall through and get stuck forever.
[*] Fixed floating graffiti in Long Wharf.
[*] Fixed invisible geometry in Deepwater.
[/list]

notes.title: With release 2.4 comes Bitball, Winter Holidays, and more!
notes.notes:
[b]A new TEAM game mode: Bitball![/b][list]
[*]Two teams compete to score points in each other's goals.
[*]The host, if one exists, can make the teams and viewers can bet on the winning team.
[*]Everyone who plays is rewarded, win or lose![/list]

[b]Play without Twitch![/b][list]
[*]A Twitch account is no longer required to play.
[*]Players can simply use their Steam name to play with their friends on Steam, join other matches, and more.
[*]A Twitch account is still required to make use of Streamote.tv's functionality.[/list]

[b]Winter Holiday content[/b][list]
[*]The holidays are here, so let's celebrate. Winter packs contain some new chilly clothing![/list]

[b]Multiple language support![/b][list]
[*]Streamline has been localized into French, German, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.[/list]

[b]Movement and Combat changes:[/b][list]
[*]We've made a number of changes to movement and combat to emphasize the fun and reduce the grief.
[*]Stun duration has been reduced from 3 to 2.5 seconds.
[*]Increased impulse of non-Hunter air attacks.
[*]Improved attack auto-aim and hit detection.
[*]Players who are stunned can not be impulsed.
[*]Punching now cancels the stun invulnerability players gain while stunned.
[*]Reduced the duration of the stun invulnerability from 2 seconds to 1 second.
[*]Movement speed while sliding has been reduced.
[*]Wall-running while boosting is now faster!
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause extremely fast speed while wall-running.[/list]

[b]Other smaller changes:[/b][list]
[*]It's now possible to create and manage your party entirely from within Streamline.
[*]Streamline can be launched directly from URLs, including joining a party and getting in their game.
[*]When you're killed for whatever reason, you're told why and how to hopefully not repeat it.
[*]In-game chat will no longer display Streamote messages from Twitch.
[*]In-game chat now supports rich text, including color and word-wrap.
[*]Point "Orbs" have been renamed "Gems."
[*]Due to the above, the "Multiball" rule has been renamed "Gem Frenzy."
[*]It's possible to skip the betting and rule purchasing phases. In the case of multiple broadcasters, everyone must agree to skip.[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*]A wide variety of obscure crashes have been fixed.
[*]Fixed a few different issues people had with hosting matches.
[*]The Floor Is Lava no longer injures players on bouncers in Game Con.
[*]The Buzzed hair now only has one set of color options instead of two.
[*]Dying from Rules no longer results in empty boosts upon respawn.
[*]Items and colors that can't be earned in packs by players don't appear as locked in the inventory anymore.
[*]No longer show lock icons on colors that don't actually exist.
[*]Fixed some issues around Slo' Thugging and Yakety Hill and how they interacted with respawn times and music.
[*]Fixed music not always playing during a match.
[*]Fixed a problem with kicking players who have already left from games/parties.[/list]

notes.title: Small patch for version 2.3.58
notes.notes:
[h1]Streamline[/h1][list]
[*]Halloween is over and there are no more Halloween packs to be won. :( But who knows what holidays are just around the corner?! ☃
[*]You can now join your friends' matches via the Steam overlay or via Steam invite.
[*]You can now see all possible cosmetic options even if you haven't unlocked them. Reach for the fashion stars!
[/list]

notes.title: 2.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
Couple of quick fixes this afternoon:
[list]
[*]The new map, Overpass, has been temporarily disabled due to bad spawn points. It'll be back soon! 
[*]We've removed a few of the ghost-only bonuses from Tag. Players couldn't trigger them but they were still showing up on Bingo cards on Streamote.
[*]In-game Twitch chat should be fixed and will no longer spam error messages when it can't connect to the chat servers. Chat should also no longer break when leaving a match and joining a new one. 
[*]Fixed a few rare crashes due to race conditions. 
[/list]
There's still a known issue with chat and switching between game modes, however. Chat will occasionally break if you switch between Tag and Elimination. If you leave the rejoin the match, it should fix the issue. A proper fix for this will be coming soon!

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.33
notes.notes:
Some quick fixes, hot off the return from TwitchCon!
[list]
[*]When a player leaves a Quick Match, they’re dropped from the host’s party. This should mean old parties aren't empty of players but "full" from a party perspective.
[*]When the host leaves the game, their Quick Match party is dropped from the game and the party.
[*]Fixed sounds that were previously marked global and were avoiding the wrath of the sound slider. For example, Deep Water and Long Wharf’s bouncers should be WAY less noisy now and you shouldn’t hear the hunter killing people from across the map.
[/list]
